metadata.title: Cartan-Ambrose-Hicks theorems and dual geodesic symmetries on statistical manifolds
metadata.abstract: We establish Cartan-Ambrose-Hicks (CAH) theorems for statistical manifolds and characterize statistical symmetric spaces by dual geodesic symmetries. These theorems determine statistical structures up to local statisticmorphism by comparing the curvature of an alpha-connection and the skewness tensor using radial geodesics and parallel displacement of that connection. The Levi-Civita formulation characterizes local statisticmorphisms by comparing the radial Jacobi operators of Riemannian curvature and the skewness tensor using Levi-Civita parallel displacement. The same characterization holds with statistical curvature in place of Riemannian curvature. For Hessian manifolds, comparison of the skewness tensor alone is necessary and sufficient. For connected statistical manifolds, we prove the equivalence between the homogeneous definition of statistical symmetric spaces and the existence of global dual geodesic symmetries at every point. The CAH theorems give the necessary and sufficient conditions for maps constructed from exponential maps of dual connections to be local dual geodesic symmetries, preserving the metric and interchanging the dual connections. Such local symmetries exist at every point if and only if the Riemannian curvature and skewness tensors are Levi-Civita parallel. For Hessian manifolds, this condition is equivalent to the equality of the Hessian and dual Hessian curvature tensors.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.progressType: 统计流形的 CAH 定理及对偶对称判据
analysis.workSummary: 建立统计流形的 Cartan–Ambrose–Hicks 型定理，以某 α 联络的径向测地线和平行移动比较曲率及偏斜张量，确定局部 statisticmorphism；另给 Levi–Civita 径向 Jacobi 算子表述，Riemann 曲率也可替换为统计曲率。Hessian 情形仅比较偏斜张量即为充要条件。对连通统计流形，证明齐性定义的统计对称空间等价于每点存在全局对偶测地对称；每点有局部对偶对称恰当且仅当 Riemann 曲率和偏斜张量均 Levi–Civita 平行，在 Hessian 情形又等价于 Hessian 与对偶 Hessian 曲率相等。
techniques: 局部及全局对偶测地对称
analysis.breakthrough: 把经典曲率决定局部几何的思想扩展到含对偶联络的统计结构，并给出局部和全局对称性的精确刻画。
analysis.limitations: 比较曲率一般还需偏斜张量；仅 Hessian 特殊类可简化。局部等价、全局对偶对称及齐性定义的结论须分别保留其连通性等假设，不能只凭一点曲率数据断言全局等距。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。PDF 全 55 页文本提取完整、页数一致且无短文本页，全文检索未观察到作者使用生成式 AI 的披露。统计流形作为数学研究对象不等于使用 AI。

analysis.priorityReason: 特殊联络和信息几何的结构定理，可为比较方法提供基础工具。
